text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Shafiq Gabr, member of the Egyptian-American Presidential Council, says U.S. Vice President Al Gore will visit Egypt in May to push forward ties between the two countries.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri will sign four cooperation agreements on double taxation and investment guarantees during a tour of Malaysia, Singapore and China.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak sent a message yesterday to United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on bilateral relations and means to boost them.
- Cabinet Affairs Minister Talaat Hammad says several firms and investors have applied to develop areas in the New Valley.

- Cabinet Affairs Minister Talaat Hammad says that an Egyptian firm signed a contract with the New Valley province to plant 10,000 acres (4,000 hectares) and set up a crude processing plant. The same firm has also applied to reclaim another 300,000 acres.
